vibe_rationale: Community-built women's climbing festival with a strong inclusion and stewardship ethos and a capped, curated field; a single discipline.
fit_notes: Outdoor, community-first climbers with a strong wellness and recovery fit and outdoor-brand precedent (The North Face, Arc'teryx). The organiser lists all ages, so the adult majority is inferred rather than recorded. Thirty listed sponsors and partners, a partnership page and a contact email. US-based, so Australian activation would need a US partner.
